Bhubaneswar_20230902T0800.title: Odisha lightning outbreak, 2 Sep 2023
Bhubaneswar_20230902T0800.description: Severe lightning day over Odisha. Forecast: HIGH at Bhubaneswar for hours 1-2. Satellite storm-location check (GK2A): CSI 0.43 in hour 1. Add the source for strike and casualty numbers before publishing any.

Bhubaneswar_20240510T0900.title: Bhubaneswar, 10 May 2024: a partial miss
Bhubaneswar_20240510T0900.description: A partial false alarm at the city; the storm it forecast formed about 157 km to the north. Shown on purpose: probabilities are calibrated to US storms and need Indian lightning data to recalibrate.
